contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, cafe and florist shopfronts, canvas awnings, utility pipes and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The bouquet, its kraft and tissue wrapping and the flower buckets are scene props, not products. The white shirt below the bag strap and the beige cardigan front are partly covered by the arms and are conservatively reconstructed. The dark brown flap crossbody is seen from one side; its far side and full strap length are inferred. No socks are visible, so none are listed. Only one gold-tone hoop is visible; the pair is inferred. Brand, metal, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

findings: All30 independent single products or matching pairs, no collages

deck.ko: 베이지 니트와 흰 셔츠, 차콜 미디 스커트.
deck.en: Beige knit, a white shirt and a charcoal midi skirt.
deck.de: Beiger Strick, weißes Hemd und anthrazitfarbener Midirock.

intro.ko: 꽃가게 앞에서 날리는 포장지 모서리를 손으로 눌러 잡는 순간입니다.
intro.en: Outside a flower shop, one hand pins down a wrapping corner caught by the breeze.
intro.de: Vor dem Blumenladen hält eine Hand die vom Wind erfasste Papierecke fest.

body.ko: 넓은 앞단의 베이지 카디건은 흰 셔츠의 칼라를 부드럽게 감쌉니다. 곧은 차콜 스커트와 검정 앵클부츠는 밝은 상체 아래 긴 세로선을 만듭니다. 짙은 갈색 크로스백은 반대 골반에서 손동작을 비우고, 작은 금색 링이 헤어 옆에 보입니다. 플래시는 니트의 짜임과 가볍게 접힌 종이의 질감을 나눕니다.
body.en: Broad cardigan borders soften the white shirt collar. A straight charcoal skirt and black ankle boots draw a long line below the pale upper layers. A dark brown crossbody rests on the opposite hip, leaving the gesture free; small gold-tone hoops show beside wavy hair. Flash separates knit texture from the lightly folded paper.
body.de: Breite Cardigankanten umgeben den weißen Hemdkragen weich. Ein gerader anthrazitfarbener Rock und schwarze Ankleboots bilden eine lange Linie unter dem hellen Oberteil. Die dunkelbraune Tasche liegt an der gegenüberliegenden Hüfte und lässt die Bewegung frei. Kleine goldfarbene Creolen zeigen sich neben welligem Haar. Blitz trennt Strickstruktur von gefaltetem Papier.

pull.ko: 부드러운 짜임 아래 곧은 스커트 선.
pull.en: Soft knit above a straight skirt line.
pull.de: Weicher Strick über einer geraden Rocklinie.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Soft knit above a straight skirt line.

tip.ko: 셔츠 앞단을 스커트에 고르게 넣고 가방을 꽃을 잡는 손 반대쪽에 두세요.
tip.en: Tuck the shirt evenly into the skirt and move the bag opposite the hand holding the flowers.
tip.de: Das Hemd gleichmäßig einstecken und die Tasche gegenüber der blumenhaltenden Hand tragen.

description.ko: 질감 있는 짜임과 넓은 앞단, 낮은 패치 포켓의 베이지 카디건입니다.
description.en: Textured beige knit with broad front borders and low patch pockets.
description.de: Strukturierter beiger Strick mit breiten Vorderkanten und tiefen aufgesetzten Taschen.

howToWear.ko: 흰 셔츠의 칼라를 카디건 밖으로 펴서 목선을 정리하세요.
howToWear.en: Set the white shirt collar outside the cardigan for a clear neckline.
howToWear.de: Den weißen Hemdkragen über den Cardigan legen und den Halsbereich ordnen.
